top_signals.title: India Shuns Pomp In Favor Of Restraint at Subdued BRICS Summit
top_signals.summary: Three years ago, New Delhi put on a spectacle when world leaders descended on India’s capital for the Group of 20 summit. Colorful murals of Indian mythology adorned the city alongside elaborate statues, floral arrangements and welcome billboards featuring Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Far right’s victory clouds Merz’s reform agenda as ally seeks changes
top_signals.summary: The rise of the Alternative for Germany has forced Germany's mainstream parties to work together in coalition to exclude the far right from power.
